finalText:
Migrated all 12 leftover call sites to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, across analytics, orders, billing, support, catalog, and accounts packages.

One file still uses `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. It's a vendored third-party file explicitly marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it alone. Worth flagging to whoever owns that dependency if the old API is going away entirely.
